title: European leader confides about UFOs on a park walk

tellings.quote: walked in the park for a while and he was telling me something very interesting about these things.

plain: Sometime in the late 1990s, an unnamed European leader went for a long walk in a park with a former president of a Russian republic named Kiran Ilum Xenov and told him 'something very interesting' about UFOs. Xenov tells Michels this himself but does not name the leader or say what he was told, though it would mean that heads of state talk about UFOs among themselves.
